multiturn.stdinPlan: send line 1; after result send line 2; after result wait 8s (process stays alive); close stdin
multiturn.note: stream-json input, --session-id <uuid>, --replay-user-messages: 2 turns in one process; system/init repeated per turn; EOF on stdin -> exit 0

eof-immediate.stdinPlan: send line 1 and close stdin immediately
eof-immediate.note: stream-json input; stdin closed right after the first message: the turn completes, then exit 0

interrupt.stdinPlan: send line 1; 1.5s after the first assistant tool_use send line 2 (interrupt); after result send line 3; after result close stdin
interrupt.note: control_request interrupt between tool calls: control_response, [Request interrupted by user], result/error_during_execution (terminal_reason aborted_streaming); next user message runs normally

interrupt-tool.note: control_request interrupt while a foreground Bash tool runs: tool_result is_error (rejected), [Request interrupted by user for tool use], result/error_during_execution (terminal_reason aborted_tools)

sigint.stdinPlan: send line 1; 1.5s after the first assistant tool_use send SIGINT to the process
sigint.note: SIGINT during a (backgrounded) Bash tool: interrupted result then exit code 0; background task killed

argv: What code word did I ask you to remember? Reply with just the word.

argv: What code word did I ask you to remember? Reply with just the word.

ask-2q.stdinPlan: send line 1 (user); on control_request can_use_tool AskUserQuestion reply at once with line 2 (allow + updatedInput.answers); after result close stdin
ask-2q.note: M0.2 (1): AskUserQuestion with 2 questions (3 + 2 options) -> control_request/can_use_tool (requires_user_interaction) -> control_response allow with updatedInput {questions, answers{questionText: label}} -> tool_result + tool_use_result.answers -> model states the chosen options

perm-allow.stdinPlan: send line 1; on control_request can_use_tool Bash reply with line 2 (allow, updatedInput = input unchanged); after result close stdin
perm-allow.note: M0.2 (2): Bash `node -e` needs approval under acceptEdits -> can_use_tool with permission_suggestions/decision_reason -> allow once -> command runs, prints 42

perm-deny.stdinPlan: send line 1; on control_request can_use_tool Bash reply with line 2 (deny + message); after result close stdin
perm-deny.note: M0.2 (3): same request answered deny -> is_error tool_result carrying the deny message verbatim, result.permission_denials[] lists it, no system/permission_denied line

perm-noflag.stdinPlan: send line 1; after result close stdin (no control_request arrives)
perm-noflag.note: M0.2: without --permission-prompt-tool stdio: AskUserQuestion is not in init.tools and the Bash request is denied at once (system/permission_denied), even with stream-json input

ask-multiselect.stdinPlan: send line 1; on can_use_tool AskUserQuestion reply with line 2 (answers value "Tests, Docs"); after result close stdin
ask-multiselect.note: M0.2: multiSelect:true question; answer = chosen labels joined with ", "; model lists both

ask-interrupt.stdinPlan: send line 1; 1.5s after the AskUserQuestion can_use_tool (left unanswered) send line 2 (interrupt); after result close stdin
ask-interrupt.note: M0.2: interrupt while a question is pending -> control_cancel_request{request_id of the can_use_tool} -> rejected tool_result -> [Request interrupted by user for tool use] -> result/error_during_execution (aborted_tools); exit 1 after EOF

ask-resume.stdinPlan: send line 1 ("Continue."); after result close stdin
ask-resume.note: M0.2: --resume of the ask-interrupt session (other cwd) + "Continue." -> the model does NOT re-ask the cancelled question

subagent-perm.stdinPlan: send line 1; answer every can_use_tool with allow; keep stdin open after the first result until the task-notification result; then close stdin
subagent-perm.note: M0.2: Agent runs in the background (is_backgrounded); the subagent Bash can_use_tool carries agent_id (= task_id = agentId); a second result has origin.kind "task-notification"

subagent-ask.stdinPlan: send line 1; keep stdin open until the task-notification result; then close stdin
subagent-ask.note: M0.2: subagents do not have AskUserQuestion (it says so); only the main agent can raise a question batch

ask-delay.stdinPlan: send line 1; answer the AskUserQuestion can_use_tool 240 s later with line 2; after result close stdin
ask-delay.note: M0.2: a pending can_use_tool waits 4 min with nothing on stdout, then the answer is taken normally

ctl-init.stdinPlan: send line 1 (initialize), then line 2 (set_permission_mode auto), then line 3 (set_permission_mode acceptEdits), each after its control_response; no user message; close stdin
ctl-init.note: M0.2: no model call. initialize response (commands, agents, models[] with supportsAutoMode, account, current_permission_mode, session_state); set auto -> error_code auto_mode_model for haiku; account email/organization replaced with placeholders

usage-ctl.stdinPlan: send line 1 (get_usage, skip_behaviors) and wait for its control_response, then line 2 (get_session_cost), then close stdin; no user message
usage-ctl.note: M0.3: no model call, no transcript written. get_usage returns rate_limits.five_hour/seven_day.utilization (0-100) + resets_at; money amounts (extra_usage.monthly_limit, spend.*.amount_minor) replaced with 0

usage-turn.stdinPlan: wait 3 s; send line 1 (get_usage) and wait for its control_response; send line 2 (user) and wait for the result; send line 3 (get_usage), line 4 (get_session_cost), each after the previous control_response; close stdin
usage-turn.note: M0.3: get_usage before and after one turn next to the turn's rate_limit_event (0.1/0.18 vs 10/18); money amounts replaced with 0

tx-main.stdinPlan: wait 2.5 s; send line 1; after result send line 2; after result close stdin
tx-main.note: M0.3: cwd with a space inside its own git repo on branch feature/tx-probe; --name writes custom-title/agent-name to the transcript; transcript in transcripts/tx-main.jsonl

handoff-start.stdinPlan: wait 1 s; send line 1 (user) and wait for the result; send line 2 (interrupt control_request) while idle; after its control_response wait 1.5 s; close stdin
handoff-start.note: M0.4 step 1 (service start + D7 Pause while idle): the idle interrupt yields only control_response{still_queued:[]}; EOF -> exit 0 in ~0.5 s. Transcript: transcripts/handoff.jsonl step 1

handoff-reattach.stdinPlan: send nothing for 5 s (idle attach: only SessionStart:resume hook_started/hook_response arrive, no system/init); send line 1 and wait for the result; close stdin
handoff-reattach.note: M0.4 step 3 (service picks the session up again after two terminal turns): same session_id, result "tangerine, kestrel" = context from the service turn and the terminal turns

handoff-midturn.stdinPlan: wait 1 s; send line 1; 2.5 s after the Bash tool_use send line 2 (interrupt); after the result close stdin
handoff-midturn.note: M0.4 D7 Pause while a foreground Bash tool runs: control_response, rejected tool_result, [Request interrupted by user for tool use], result/error_during_execution (aborted_tools); EOF -> exit 1 (a clean pause, not a failure). Transcript: transcripts/handoff-mid.jsonl
